name: Private Pilot — Airplane Airman Certification Standards
scope_for_track_inference: Tasks listed here are the ones whose performance can be observed (or partially observed) from an ADS-B / live track. Tasks marked detect=knowledge are oral-exam items not detectable from path and are omitted. Tasks marked detect=partial can be inferred from track shape but with caveats noted.

areas_of_operation.name: Preflight Preparation
areas_of_operation.note: Ground-only / knowledge tasks; not detectable from track.

tasks.name: Engine Start
tasks.notes: Existence implied if the track starts with on_ground samples followed by taxi.

tasks.name: Communications, Light Signals, and Runway Lighting Systems
Traffic Patterns

performance_standard.ground_track: maintained within 1/4 mile of the pattern

tasks.track_rule: phase 'pattern' duration ≥ 60 s within 2.5 nm of an airport and AGL 100–1500 ft.

tasks.name: Normal Takeoff and Climb
tasks.track_rule: Synthetic 'takeoff' event emitted by the identifier on every on_ground→airborne transition. Preempted by IV.E (short-field) or IV.C (soft-field) when those differentiators fire.

performance_standard.touchdown_point: within 400 ft beyond a specified point

tasks.name: Soft-Field Takeoff and Climb

performance_standard.technique: lift-off as soon as possible; accelerate in ground effect

tasks.track_rule: acsML soft_field_takeoff detection. Heuristic only — pilot input cannot be confirmed from track.
tasks.notes: Defaults to IV.A Normal Takeoff unless this differentiator detection fires.

tasks.name: Soft-Field Approach and Landing
tasks.track_rule: acsML soft_field_landing detection (touchdown sink rate < 100 fpm). Suspected only.

tasks.name: Short-Field Takeoff and Maximum Performance Climb
tasks.track_rule: acsML short_field_takeoff detection (sustained ≥ 700 fpm from low AGL).

tasks.name: Short-Field Approach and Landing
tasks.track_rule: acsML short_field_landing detection (sustained ≥ 600 fpm into touchdown).

tasks.name: Go-Around/Rejected Landing

performance_standard.decision_promptness: decision and configuration changes made promptly

tasks.track_rule: phaseML touch_and_go event (a non-full-stop landing that climbed out). Distinguishes from landed_full_stop via the post-touchdown climbout.

tasks.name: Steep Turns

performance_standard.turn_amount: 360° in one direction or 180° each side

tasks.track_rule: phaseML steep_turn detection with bank evidence ≥ 40° (within ACS tolerance).

tasks.name: Ground Reference Maneuvers — Rectangular Course
tasks.track_rule: Four 90° turns in sequence centered on a fixed ground reference; legs roughly parallel/perpendicular; AGL 600–1000.
tasks.notes: phaseML doesn't have a rectangular-course detector yet. Added in acsML/features.js.

tasks.name: Ground Reference Maneuvers — S-Turns Across a Road
Ground Reference Maneuvers — Turns Around a Point
Pilotage and Dead Reckoning
tasks.track_rule: Long XC leg (> 25 nm) with direct line and altitude held; tortuosity < 1.2.
tasks.notes: Can't tell from track whether pilotage vs GPS navigation was used.

tasks.name: Diversion
tasks.track_rule: Mid-XC heading change > 60° followed by sustained new heading to a different airport.
tasks.notes: Can't tell intentional diversion from a planned waypoint without flight plan.

tasks.name: Power-Off Stalls
tasks.track_rule: phaseML stall_recovery detection whose PRE-EVENT throttle estimate (5 s window before the break) is LOW (< 0.3 = idle / approach config).
tasks.notes: Was selector='pre_vs_negative' before throttle was available; throttle is the direct signal.

tasks.name: Power-On Stalls
tasks.track_rule: phaseML stall_recovery detection whose PRE-EVENT throttle estimate is HIGH (> 0.7 = climb / takeoff config).

tasks.name: Straight-and-Level Flight (Instruments)
tasks.notes: Same path shape as VFR straight-and-level. Not detectable as ACS task without hood/instrument context.

tasks.name: Recovery from Unusual Flight Attitudes (Instruments)
tasks.track_rule: Sudden large altitude excursion (> 500 ft) + heading deviation > 30° with recovery within 30 s.

tasks.name: Emergency Descent
tasks.notes: Filter chain: (a) phaseML emergency_descent fires on any 1200+ fpm sustained descent, (b) spiraling===true gates out straight-line airline descents, (c) throttle gate requires meanThrottle < 0.4 (idle / drag descent). The combo eliminates airline routine descents that include procedural turns (they keep the throttle on).

tasks.name: Emergency Approach and Landing (Simulated)
tasks.track_rule: acsML emergency_approach_landing detector: sustained descent (VS < -300 fpm, 60+ s) terminating < 800 AGL more than 3 nm from any airport, followed by a sustained climb (recovery). Speed must stay within 50 kts range (no rapid deceleration). PLUS mean throttle during the descent < 0.4 (idle / glide).

performance_standard.field_selection: based on wind, suitable surface, obstacle clearance

tasks.notes: Operator feedback (2026-06-01): proper IX.B looks like a power-off descent toward a chosen field with stable best-glide speed. From track, indistinguishable from a real emergency that recovered. Energy heuristic: total mechanical energy (KE + PE) decays at drag-only rate (~3-5 kts equivalent altitude per second) — to be added in v0.3.

areas_of_operation.name: Multiengine Operations
areas_of_operation.note: Not applicable to single-engine Private Pilot.

tasks.name: Night Operations
tasks.track_rule: Any flight whose takeoff or landing time is between 1 hr after sunset and 1 hr before sunrise at the airport's lat/lon.
tasks.notes: ACS task XI is not flight-tested in PP ACS — it's knowledge — but the same time-of-day criterion is used for FAR 61.57(b) currency.
